worldcombat.skill.aquacutter.summary: Pressurized water is expelled as a straight, extremely fast, narrow line that cuts like a blade: each foe it crosses takes a slicing hit and is drenched, and one jet pierces up to several. The fastest, straightest and narrowest of the four, with the family's raised critical chance.
worldcombat.skill.aquacutter.description: The jet deals %1$s slicing damage and lands critical hits more often.
The jet fires at %1$s blocks per tick over %2$s blocks with a %3$s block radius.
One jet pierces up to %1$s foes and drenches those it cuts for %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.aquacutter.lance.on: Lance form: higher power, one more foe pierced and a narrower jet, at slower fire and a longer cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.aquacutter.lance.off: Scatter form: faster fire, a wider jet and a shorter cooldown, at lower power.
worldcombat.skill.aquacutter.timing: Range %1$s blocks; %2$s s preparation, %3$s s recovery, %4$s PP, %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.aquacutter.growth.0: From level %1$s the jet rises to %2$s and pierces %3$s foes.
worldcombat.skill.aquacutter.growth.1: From level %1$s the jet rises to %2$s, the range to %3$s blocks and the drench to %4$s.
worldcombat.skill.aquacutter.use.0: A straight, extremely fast water line cuts the foe
worldcombat.skill.aquacutter.use.1: Pierces a whole line of targets
worldcombat.skill.aquacutter.use.2: Drenches what it cuts, opening a wet window
On: 112% power, one more pierced foe and a 0.05 blocks narrower jet, at 88% jet speed and +7 cooldown. Off: 112% jet speed, 0.08 blocks wider and -5 cooldown, at 94% power.
Beyond this distance it closes in instead of firing. Larger values cut from further away.
On: with two or more foes lined up in the jet direction, it fires first to cut the whole line. Off: it ranks the jet as an ordinary ranged slash.
